subject: general
question: Famous revolutionary Ashutosh Kuila was member of which of the revolutionary organization?
solution:
**The correct answer is - __Vidyutwahini__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Vidyutwahini__**

 __
 
• **Ashutosh Kuila__** was a member of **__Vidyutwahini__**, a revolutionary organization that actively fought against British colonial rule in India.
 
• **__Vidyutwahini__** was known for its underground activities and armed resistance aimed at overthrowing the British regime.
 
• It focused on recruiting young and passionate individuals dedicated to the cause of independence.
 
• The organization emphasized secrecy and discipline among its members to avoid detection by the British intelligence.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ **

__
 
• **Other Revolutionary Organizations__**

 __
 
• **Hindustan Republican Association (HRA)__**

 __
 
• Founded in 1924 by revolutionaries such as **Ram Prasad Bismil__** and **__Chandra Shekhar Azad__**.
 
• Its primary aim was to organize armed uprisings to achieve independence.
 
• The Kakori Train Robbery of 1925 was one of its most notable activities.
 
 
 
• **__Gadar Party__**
 __
 
• Formed in 1913 by Indian immigrants in the United States and Canada, such as **Lala Har Dayal__** and **__Sohan Singh Bhakna__**.
 
• Primarily focused on inciting rebellion among Indians in the British Indian Army during World War I.
 
• Its goal was to establish a free and independent India through revolutionary means.
 
 
 
• **__Anushilan Samiti__**
 __
 
• A secret revolutionary society formed in Bengal in the early 20th century.
 
• Prominent leaders included **Aurobindo Ghosh__** and **__Barindra Kumar Ghosh__**.
 
• It was involved in political assassinations and bomb-making to target British officials.
 
 
 
 
 
• **__Role of Revolutionary Organizations__**
 
 
• These organizations played a crucial role in creating awareness about the need for independence.
 
• They inspired the youth to join the freedom movement and resist British rule through bold and fearless acts.
 
• Although their methods were often violent, their contributions significantly influenced India's struggle for independence.
